dialogues.jp:
夕食後、テレビを観るでもなく、ソファーに座っ
て、台所で洗い物をしている先輩をぼんやりと
眺め続ける。
dialogues.en:
After dinner I sat on the couch without turning the TV on,
and vaguely watched Moe-sempai washing dishes.
dialogues.text:
After dinner I sat on the couch without turning the TV on,
and vaguely watched Moe-sempai washing dishes.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「どうしたんですか？」
dialogues.en: "What's wrong?"
dialogues.text: "What's wrong?"

dialogues.jp:
ゆっくりとした動作で、食器を洗い終えた萌先
輩が台所から出てくる。
dialogues.en:
Moe-sempai came out of the slowly kitchen as she finished
washing the dishes.
dialogues.text:
Moe-sempai came out of the slowly kitchen as she finished
washing the dishes.

dialogues.jp: 「いや、なんでもないですよ」
dialogues.en: "No, it's nothing."
dialogues.text: "No, it's nothing."

dialogues.jp:
帰ってしまうまでに、少しでもたくさん萌先輩
の姿を見ておこうと思ったんだけど、さすがに
本人相手では照れてしまう。
dialogues.en:
I'm trying to memorize as much of this scene as I could
before she returns home, but I can't say that to her face.
dialogues.text:
I'm trying to memorize as much of this scene as I could
before she returns home, but I can't say that to her face.

dialogues.jp: 改まった顔をして、萌先輩が俺の前に立つ。
dialogues.en: Moe-sempai stood in front of me with a serious face.
dialogues.text: Moe-sempai stood in front of me with a serious face.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「どうもお世話になりました」
dialogues.en: "Thank you very much for everything."
dialogues.text: "Thank you very much for everything."

dialogues.jp: そう言って、深々と頭を下げる。
dialogues.en: She spoke and deeply bowed at me.
dialogues.text: She spoke and deeply bowed at me.

dialogues.jp:
「いや……お世話になったのは俺のほうなんだ
　けど……」
dialogues.en: "Well...... I'm the one who should be thanking you......"
dialogues.text: "Well...... I'm the one who should be thanking you......"

dialogues.jp: 俺は萌先輩の頭を上げさせる。
dialogues.en: I made her look back up.
dialogues.text: I made her look back up.

dialogues.jp: 「こちらこそ、どうも。助かりました」
dialogues.en: "Thank you very much for your support."
dialogues.text: "Thank you very much for your support."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「いえ。お役に立てて嬉しいです」
dialogues.en: "You're welcome. I'm glad I was able to help you."
dialogues.text: "You're welcome. I'm glad I was able to help you."

dialogues.jp: ニッコリ微笑む俺に、萌先輩も相好を崩す。
dialogues.en: We both smiled at each other.
dialogues.text: We both smiled at each other.

dialogues.jp: 「明日の何時に帰るんです？」
dialogues.en: "What time you going back home tomorrow?"
dialogues.text: "What time you going back home tomorrow?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「放課後には業者の人が来ますので、たぶん、
　夕方頃だと思います」
dialogues.en:
"The moving company will be here after school, so I'll
probably leave around early evening."
dialogues.text:
"The moving company will be here after school, so I'll
probably leave around early evening."

dialogues.jp:
学園でも会えるというのに、とても寂しい気分
になる。ただ単に、普通の状態に戻るだけじゃ
ないか……。

先輩がいつもと変わらぬ穏やかな笑みを浮かべ、
唐突に提案する。
dialogues.en:
I know I'll still see her around in the school, but I was
starting to feel very sad.
dialogues.text:
I know I'll still see her around in the school, but I was
starting to feel very sad.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
今度は顔を輝かせるように笑う。
dialogues.en: "Yes?"
dialogues.text: "Yes?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「後少しですよ、朝倉くん」
dialogues.en: "Can we go to...... your room?"
dialogues.text: "Can we go to...... your room?"

dialogues.jp:
先輩が上り階段の頂から、微笑みながら手を差
し伸べている。
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: 「先輩、見かけによらず健脚なんですね」
dialogues.en: To my room......?
dialogues.text: To my room......?

dialogues.jp: 先輩の白い手を握りながら応える。

夜の高台から見渡す町の夜景は、胸に迫るもの
があった。
dialogues.en: "Is that okay?"
dialogues.text: "Is that okay?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「あの灯りの一つ一つで、みんなが、笑ったり
　泣いたりしてるんですよ。……なんだか切な
　いですけど」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.jp: 俺も似たような気持ちだった。
dialogues.en: She answered, blushing a little bit.
dialogues.text: She answered, blushing a little bit.

dialogues.jp: 悲しい訳ではない。多分、幸せすぎるのだろう。
dialogues.en: "I guess we'll be late for school tomorrow......"
dialogues.text: "I guess we'll be late for school tomorrow......"

dialogues.jp: 先輩が俺に微笑みかける。
dialogues.en: I murmured and urged Moe-sempai to go upstairs.
dialogues.text: I murmured and urged Moe-sempai to go upstairs.

dialogues.jp: ◆萌先輩は明日に帰る◆
dialogues.en: ◆Moe-sempai's leaving tomorrow◆
dialogues.text: ◆Moe-sempai's leaving tomorrow◆

dialogues.jp: 萌先輩が、明日帰ると言ってきた。
dialogues.en: Moe-sempai's going back to her home tomorrow.
dialogues.text: Moe-sempai's going back to her home tomorrow.

dialogues.jp:
そして、俺達は、二人して、俺の部屋へ行った
のだった。
dialogues.en: Then, we decided to go up to my room together.
dialogues.text: Then, we decided to go up to my room together.
